name: Gold (fear gauge)
summary: Gold near $4,128, up 5.9% on the week but 6.6% lower over three months
state: Gold futures were near $4,128 early on 5 Nov, 6.6% lower over three months, inside the Normal band of −8% to +10% (Yahoo Finance). The price rose 5.9% over the past week, below the 7% single-week Alert line, and remains about 22% under its 52-week high.
for_you: Gold has rebounded but is not signalling a flight to safety. Its price can move sharply with interest-rate expectations.
why: Gold is the oldest crisis hedge; disorderly surges signal fear about currencies, inflation or geopolitics.
drivers: Real interest rates, central-bank buying, geopolitical fear, dollar moves.

rubric.alert: 3-month gain > 20%, or a single-week move > 7% either way.
